verdict.rationale: Trilegal has a dedicated Intellectual Property group page that says it advises on 'the full spectrum of IP, including... patents'. The page also covers patent litigation and SEP/FRAND licensing, but the evidence is mostly about enforcement and licensing, not prosecution. Missing for 10: any evidence of patent drafting, filing or prosecution before patent offices; portfolio-strategy or defensive-positioning work; named patent practitioners; independent corroboration or rankings for patent prosecution.
